subject: [PATCH v2 1/5] btrfs: use an on-stack path in btrfs_insert_orphan_item()

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Applied his Reviewed-by tag without comment.

2026-08-05.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the performance and reliability of Btrfs by reducing memory allocation failures in critical paths, such as btrfs_insert_orphan_item(). The first patch in the series addresses a specific issue where a path allocation failure can lead to a transaction abort. It does this by allocating a btrfs_path on the stack instead of dynamically.
